meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 当你让 Claude 做 git 相关操作时,它会先读最近 30 条提交记录,判断这个仓库的提交风格和语言,再把改动拆成多个小提交、按依赖顺序执行,并处理 rebase/squash 与历史查找。
howto.when: 只要涉及任何 git 操作就会触发,例如你提到 “commit”、“rebase”、“squash” 等关键词,或问某个改动是谁、什么时候加进去的。

say.text: 把这些改动拆成几个提交
say.note: 先输出风格分析和提交计划,再执行

say.text: 把最近这三个提交 squash 成一个
say.note: 走 rebase 流程整理历史

say.text: 这个函数是谁写的?什么时候加的
say.note: 进入历史查找模式定位提交

howto.what_en: When you ask for any git work, Claude first reads the last 30 commits to detect the repo's commit style and language, then splits changes into several small commits run in dependency order, and handles rebase/squash plus history lookups.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any git operation — mentioning “commit”, “rebase”, “squash” and similar, or asking who wrote a change and when it was added.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several commits
say_en.note: It prints a style analysis and commit plan first

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one
say_en.note: Runs the rebase workflow to clean history

say_en.text: Who wrote this function and when was it added?
say_en.note: Switches to history-search mode to locate the commit
